label: Bible Study
prompt: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, _____ ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
verse: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
note: Guidance with surround sound — a word behind you saying 'this is the way.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For I have satiated the _____ soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verse: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
note: God refills every weary, sorrowful soul — and Jeremiah wakes in the next verse saying his sleep was sweet.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock _____.
verse: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
note: 'Crew' is the old past tense of crow — Peter's third denial and the rooster's timing were exactly as Jesus foretold.

label: Deep Water
prompt: God setteth the _____ in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verse: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
note: God's homemaking: he places the lonely in families and leads prisoners out.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye who turn judgment to _____, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
verse: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
note: Israel turned justice into 'wormwood' — bitter as gall. Amos soon calls for judgment to run down as waters (5:24).
